note: Per-image provenance checks under R052's THINGSplus terms reading (framework §8.2 (ii); handoff 41b67d26). Each record was observed by R084 (Claude) in Chrome on the date given: a TinEye reverse-image search of the THINGSplus release file (tineye.com, file upload), then the earliest matching source page, whose 'Published date', creator and displayed licence are recorded as shown. Pixabay's Terms of Service section 4 (https://pixabay.com/service/terms/, 'Last updated: November 18, 2024', read 2026-10-01): 'CC0 Content on the Service is any content which lists a "Published date" prior to January 9, 2019.' Every Pixabay page now displays 'Free for use under the Pixabay Content License' whatever its date, so the licence basis is decided by the published date under that section, not by the page banner. Status: eligible (source found, CC0 or public domain at source), ineligible (source shows a non-CC0, non-PD licence or a conflicting claim; replaced through the seeded order by pool.py), not_found (publishable by reference only). Stock-site rows TinEye marks SPONSORED are advertisements, not matches, and are not counted as conflicting claims.
method: TinEye reverse image search (upload of the THINGSplus release file) -> earliest matching source page -> 'Show details' panel (published date) and the licence line
